people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: But Yahweh hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go.
translations.bsb: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not let the Israelites go.
translations.kjv: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go.
translations.asv: But Jehovah hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he did not let the children of Israel go.
